title: Use nested environments
description: This example creates global, function, and inner frames to show lookup, assignment, and shadowing.

steps.description: The global frame defines x and y.
A function child frame defines a and b. An inner child frame defines temp.
These lookups find temp locally, a in the function frame, and x in the global frame.
assign updates a in the frame where it already exists, so func_env reads 42.
define creates a new inner x that shadows global x while leaving the global binding unchanged.
